desenho: Pre-declared design note, section 'R-O3' (single execution; nothing goes into the text at this stage)
diario: Execution log for this run, entries D1-D10 (not distributed).
criterio_literal: In each condition: recomputed O3 cap = largest upper bound of |dMAE| among the three pairs (v23 x mlp, tree x v23, tree x mlp), same population as the condition, same bootstrap (B = 10,000, seed 42), transect unit (footprint as a secondary reading, not a confirmation). Above 30 m, 'demonstrado' if the lower bounds of A (mean and median) and of the MAE reduction lie above the O3 cap of the condition.

operacionalizacao.primario_D3: ARV2.veredito_O(A and reduction of the condition in the transect and footprint units, O3 cap of the transect) -- the same function as the (O) verdicts against the two networks, only with the cap swapped; 'sustentado' = demonstrated
operacionalizacao.secundario_s1: Only the transect row (transect bounds against the transect O3 ceiling)
operacionalizacao.secundario_s2: S7.criterio_O3 (ceiling per unit: footprint against footprint; combined verdict)
operacionalizacao.limite_superior_abs_dMAE: max(|lo|,|hi|) of the bootstrap 95% CI of the median MAE difference per unit (REF.testar via S7.contrastes_por_unidade)

populacoes_D10.C3: ANA.montar_populacao_com_anadem + S8.marcar, undisturbed cells and anchors (lossyear 2011-2023)
populacoes_D10.C4-C5: S1.recomputar_populacao_e_guardas + S1.classificar_lnb_e_horn; anchors from the S1v2 dump (classe_lnb / classe_C)

operacionalizacao.produto_tree: glo30 - mean of the 5 seeds (delta_amazonia_arvore_f2_s7_seed*.npz), S7.instalar_tree_em_montar

vereditos.20-30m: not demonstrated against the tree model
